en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural valley with forested hills in the background. In the foreground stands a two‑storey half‑timbered house with shutters, likely an inn or guesthouse, beside a curved unpaved road. Nearby are several traditional farmhouses and barns scattered on gentle grassy slopes. The scene is quiet and pastoral, with dense coniferous forest covering the hillside behind the buildings. There is a signboard on the main house but the text is too small and blurred to read.
